_comment: Choose one path at level 2. Later levels grant its skills automatically. All standard-path skills have working effects. Fieldworks are purchased reusable equipment, placed before combat; at most three may be carried. Barricades stop movement and shots, stakes stop movement only. The Veined remains story-only.

paths.name: Marshal
paths.text: Leads the line: who moves first, and how hard they hit.

nodes.name: First Orders
nodes.text: Before each battle, order one of your stacks to act first, ahead of every enemy.

nodes.name: Rally
nodes.text: +1 attack for every troop stack.

nodes.name: Vanguard
nodes.text: Order two stacks to open the battle, in the order you set.

nodes.name: Battle Plan
nodes.text: Order three stacks to open the battle.

nodes.name: Battle Standard
nodes.text: +2 defence for every troop stack.

nodes.name: Hold the Line
nodes.text: +1 defence for every troop stack.

nodes.name: Veteran Command
nodes.text: +2 attack for every troop stack.

nodes.name: Oathbound
nodes.text: +2 defence for every troop stack.

nodes.name: Marshal of the North
nodes.text: +2 attack and +2 defence for every troop stack.

paths.name: Siegemaster
paths.text: Shape the battlefield. Buy portable fieldworks and place them before the first turn.

nodes.name: Field Carpentry
nodes.text: +2 defence. Unlock one reusable barricade: blocks movement and line of sight. Buy it below for 250 gold and 3 wood.

nodes.name: Prepared Volleys
nodes.text: Your archers fire at an enemy that moves closer, once per round. Barricades also block these shots.

nodes.name: Field Engineering
nodes.text: +1 defence. Carry two fieldworks. Unlock stakes: block movement while arrows pass over them.

nodes.name: Supply Wagons
nodes.text: +1 attack. Carry up to three fieldworks into each battle.

nodes.name: Iron Bracing
nodes.text: +1 defence for every troop stack.

nodes.name: Fortification Drill
nodes.text: +2 defence for every troop stack.

nodes.name: Siege Ammunition
nodes.text: +2 attack for every troop stack.

nodes.name: Marching Engineers
nodes.text: +1 movement each day and +1 troop defence.

nodes.name: Master of Sieges
nodes.text: +2 attack and +2 defence for every troop stack.

paths.name: Quartermaster
paths.text: Wars are won on the road: marches, scouts, silver and supply.

nodes.name: Forced March
nodes.text: +2 movement every day.

nodes.name: Pathfinders
nodes.text: +2 sight: outriders see what waits ahead.

nodes.name: Requisition
nodes.text: +250 gold a day.

nodes.name: Supply Lines
nodes.text: +25% weekly recruits in your towns.

nodes.name: Caravans
nodes.text: +250 gold each day.

nodes.name: Remounts
nodes.text: +1 movement each day.

nodes.name: Far Scouts
nodes.text: +2 sight on the adventure map.

nodes.name: War Chest
nodes.text: +500 gold each day.

nodes.name: Quartermaster-General
nodes.text: +1 movement each day and +25% weekly recruits.

wildcard.name: The Veined
wildcard.text: Not the Compact's. What the obelisks teach, offered by the story, to anyone, at a price.

nodes.name: Vein Sight
nodes.text: See through the fog along the veins.

nodes.name: Grave Harvest
nodes.text: Raise the lowest dead of your enemies after battle.

nodes.name: Listen Below
nodes.text: Hear what is under the map.
